what: How the rolling-origin results were produced
title: From the classical model to lunarcast
text: code data-raw/rolling_sapi.R package repository.
code: hol  <- list(adha = adha, fitri = fitri) spec <- classic$spec classic_models <- lapply(seq_len(6), function(i) {   force(i)   function(y, h) forecast(calvar_classic(y, adha, spec$trend[i], spec$season[i]),                           h = h)$mean }) names(classic_models) <- paste0("classic_", spec$model)  # the lunarcast variants share the calendar selected at each origin lunarcast_variant <- function(...) {   function(y, h) {     base <- lunarcast(y, hol, select = "aicc")     fit  <- lunarcast(y, hol, window = base$window, effect = base$effect, ...)     forecast(fit, h = h)$mean   } } lunarcast_models <- list(   lunarcast_aicc = function(y, h) forecast(lunarcast(y, hol, select = "aicc"), h = h)$mean,   lunarcast_none = lunarcast_variant(season = "none", select = "aicc"),   lunarcast      = lunarcast_variant() ) r <- rolling_origin(sapi, adha, c(classic_models, lunarcast_models), first = 2012) rolling_summary(r)

title: Panduan lunarcast (Bahasa Indonesia)
text: Tahun Hijriah sekitar 354 hari, sedangkan tahun Masehi sekitar 365 hari. Akibatnya Idul Fitri dan Idul Adha maju sekitar 11 hari setiap tahun, dan pada data bulanan efeknya pindah ke bulan sebelumnya kira-kira setiap 2,8 tahun. Imlek dan Paskah juga bergeser, meski dalam rentang sekitar satu bulan.

title: Panduan lunarcast (Bahasa Indonesia)
text: Model yang umum dipakai adalah regresi dengan galat ARIMA dan dummy bulan hari raya: \[ Y_t = \beta_0 + \beta_1 t + S_t + \alpha V_t + N_t, \qquad V_t = 1 \text{ jika bulan } t \text{ memuat hari raya.} \] Model ini berasumsi bahwa (1) hari raya hanya memengaruhi bulan yang memuatnya, (2) efeknya sama setiap tahun, dan (3) efeknya aditif. Ketiganya tidak berlaku pada data pencarian “sapi”: Idul Adha 31 Juli 2020 justru memuncak di Agustus, efeknya hampir nol pada 2004 lalu lebih dari tiga kali lipat sekitar 2015–2019, dan sisa efek yang tidak tertangkap dummy bocor ke komponen musiman sehingga muncul “puncak hantu” di bulan lama setelah hari raya pindah bulan.

title: Panduan lunarcast (Bahasa Indonesia)
text: Regresor jendela. Dummy diganti dengan porsi hari dalam jendela \([D_{hj} + a_h,\ D_{hj} + b_h]\) di sekitar hari raya yang jatuh di setiap bulan: \[w_{hj,t} = \frac{|W_{hj} \cap P_t|}{|W_{hj}|}.\] Jendela \((a_h, b_h)\) dipilih otomatis. Jendela \((0, 0)\) sama dengan dummy klasik. Efek multiplikatif. Pada skala log, hari raya mengalikan level dengan \(e^{\alpha}\), bukan menambah angka tetap. Efek dua level. Setiap kejadian punya efek sendiri \(\alpha_{hj}\) (level 1), dan efek kejadian berikutnya diramal dari deret efek sebelumnya (level 2): \[\hat\alpha_{h,J+1} = g(\hat\alpha_{h1}, \ldots, \hat\alpha_{hJ}),\] dengan \(g\) dipilih dari rata-rata, rata-rata tertimbang, random walk, SES, atau damped Holt lewat validasi silang. Struktur tren dan musiman. Jenis tren ditentukan uji KPSS: tren stokastik selalu menjadi kandidat, sedangkan tren deterministik hanya bila uji menunjukkan deret stasioner di sekitar tren. Musiman (tanpa musiman, Fourier, dummy, atau SARMA) dipilih lewat ramalan satu tahun ke depan dari beberapa titik asal (validasi silang). Aturan satu galat baku memilih struktur paling sederhana yang galatnya masih dalam satu galat baku dari yang terbaik. Outlier (opsional). AO, LS, dan TC dideteksi di luar periode hari raya. Model klasik adalah kasus khusus lunarcast: skala asli, jendela \((0, 0)\), efek konstan, satu hari raya, dan struktur yang ditetapkan.

title: How lunarcast works
text: usual approach regression ARIMA errors dummy month contains holiday: \[ Y_t = \underbrace{\beta_0 + \beta_1 t}_{\text{trend}} + \underbrace{S_t}_{\text{seasonality}}       + \underbrace{\alpha V_t}_{\text{holiday}} + \underbrace{N_t}_{\text{ARIMA error}}, \qquad V_t = \begin{cases} 1 & \text{month } t \text{ contains holiday,}\\ 0 & \text{otherwise.} \end{cases} \] trend either deterministic (regressor \(\beta_1 t\)) stochastic (differencing \(N_t\)). seasonality set monthly dummies, Fourier terms \(\sum_{k=1}^{K}\{a_k \sin(2\pi k t/12) + b_k \cos(2\pi k t/12)\}\), seasonal ARIMA error. Crossing two choices gives six structures, m1 m6, available calvar_classic() calvar_classic_all(). holiday part makes three assumptions: Timing: holiday affects month contains , fully, month. Leakage seasonality (“ghost peaks”). Whatever holiday dummy explain stays residuals holiday month. seasonal autoregression \(N_t = \Phi N_{t-12} + \varepsilon_t\) predicts part residual twelve months later. holiday moved previous month meantime, model forecasts peak month longer contains holiday, small peak month . title: How lunarcast works
text: lunarcast models \(z_t = \log y_t\) default, holiday multiplies level \(e^{\alpha}\) instead adding fixed number. matters level series changes: three times low level three times high level different numbers searches. share \(w\) window falls month, natural assumption share \(w\) extra activity falls , level month multiplied \(1 + (e^{\alpha} - 1)\,w\). log scale achieved regressor \[ \tilde w = \frac{\log\{1 + (e^{\alpha} - 1)\,w\}}{\alpha}, \qquad \alpha\,\tilde w = \log\{1 + (e^{\alpha} - 1)\,w\}. \] example, full effect triples level (\(e^{\alpha} = 3\)) 64% window August, August rises \(1 + 2 \times 0.64 = 2.28\) times, \(3^{0.64} = 2.02\) times, plugging \(w\) log model give. \(\tilde w\) depends \(\alpha\), lunarcast estimates model, updates \(\tilde w\) re-estimates (two iterations enough). lambda = NULL model stays original scale shares used directly.

title: How lunarcast works
text: let effect change time, every occurrence gets effect. Level 1 (estimation): \[ z_t = \sum_h \sum_j \alpha_{hj}\,\tilde w_{hj,t} + \mathbf{x}_t^\top\boldsymbol\beta + N_t . \] occurrence effects \(\alpha_{hj}\) estimated jointly trend, seasonality ARIMA error maximum likelihood. constant effect special case \(\alpha_{hj} = \alpha_h\); lunarcast chooses two AICc requires least six occurrences two-level effect. Level 2 (forecasting next effect). effect future occurrence observed, forecast sequence past effects: \[ \hat\alpha_{h,J+1} = g(\hat\alpha_{h1}, \ldots, \hat\alpha_{hJ}). \] Five rules \(g\) compared: rule forecasts every past effect effects , rule smallest mean squared one-step error used: \[ \mathrm{CV}(g) = \frac{1}{|\mathcal J|}\sum_{j \\mathcal J} \big\{\hat\alpha_{hj} - g(\hat\alpha_{h1}, \ldots, \hat\alpha_{h,j-1})\big\}^2 . \] error measures uncertain next effect , added forecast variance (Section 9). plot() fitted model shows estimated effects forecast next occurrence.

title: How lunarcast works
text: rest model, \(\mathbf{x}_t^\top\boldsymbol\beta + N_t\), uses building blocks classical model: deterministic stochastic trend seasonality, Fourier terms, seasonal dummies seasonal ARIMA errors. Three design choices matter. Dummies Fourier terms. \(K = s/2\) (six monthly data) Fourier terms span exactly space \(s - 1\) seasonal dummies, dummy Fourier models nested. m1 m2 (m3 m4) classical approach give almost fit \(K = 5\). calendar comes first. windows effect types selected seasonal structure. poor calendar component, seasonal ARMA error absorbs holiday misfit looks far better : sapi, advantage seasonal ARMA errors best deterministic seasonality falls 67 AICc points dummy calendar 14 selected calendar. Tests choose trend, cross-validation chooses seasonality. Information criteria compare models different orders differencing. lunarcast therefore lets KPSS tests decide trend, auto.arima() : stochastic trend (differencing) always candidate, deterministic linear trend tests indicate series trend-stationary, extrapolating straight line risky slope series changed (sapi, rose 2019 fell afterwards). seasonal structure chosen forecasting, since good -sample fit good forecast: lunarcast refits every candidate end last cv_years years (five default), forecasts next year full calendar machinery computes RMSE. default applies one-standard-error rule: among structures whose cross-validated RMSE within one standard error best, takes simplest, \[ c^\ast = \arg\min_c \{\kappa_c : \mathrm{CV}_c \le \mathrm{CV}_{\min} + \mathrm{SE}_{\min}\}, \] \(\kappa_c\) counts structural parameters (trend slope, Fourier dummy columns, seasonal ARMA terms). Simple structures less likely repeat last year’s anomalies. trend = "cv" deterministic stochastic trends compared cross-validation well. Every model, including refitted cross-validation, required stationary invertible; fit re-estimated maximum likelihood.

title: How lunarcast works
text: outliers = TRUE, lunarcast looks additive outliers (\(\omega\,(t = \tau)\)), level shifts (\(\omega\,(t \ge \tau)\)) temporary changes (\(\omega\,0.7^{t-\tau} (t \ge \tau)\)) among largest robustly standardised residuals, keeps \(|t| > 3.5\). Months covered two-level holiday excluded, outlier indistinguishable year’s holiday effect.

title: How lunarcast works
text: lunarcast() runs steps: Choose preliminary trend type KPSS tests series adjusted simple calendar. every holiday, choose constant two-level effect AICc. every holiday, choose window \((a_h, b_h)\) grid AICc. title: lunarcast: Calendar Variation Models for Moving Holidays
text: lunarcast adalah package R untuk memodelkan dan meramal deret waktu bulanan atau kuartalan yang dipengaruhi hari raya bergerak, seperti Idul Fitri, Idul Adha, Imlek, dan Paskah. Dibanding model variasi kalender klasik (dummy bulan hari raya dengan efek tetap), lunarcast: menyebar efek hari raya ke beberapa bulan sesuai porsi hari dalam jendela di sekitar hari raya, dengan jendela yang dipilih otomatis; memberi setiap kejadian hari raya efeknya sendiri dan meramal efek kejadian berikutnya dari deret efek sebelumnya (model dua level); memilih struktur tren dan musiman lewat validasi silang yang sadar kalender. Instalasi: pak::pak("novrisuhermi/lunarcast"). Panduan lengkap berbahasa Indonesia: vignette("panduan-indonesia").
